item.title: Memory-safety roadmaps: Rust without the rewrite

item.title: The EU Cyber Resilience Act: what UK software firms need to know
item.description: Reporting duties started in September 2026 and the main obligations follow in December 2027. A practical guide for UK companies selling software into the EU.

item.title: Why your inference bill is a compiler problem
item.description: LLM inference is usually limited by memory bandwidth, not raw compute. That makes fusion, quantisation and kernel work the biggest levers on cost and latency.
